message: The moment I entered the old school building on my way to the Student Council room, I ran into Sacchin.

name: Sacchin
message: 「The Takahashi Expedition Team is recruiting staff right now! You should join too, Synn-kun!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nope, not at all! We just wander around Ryuusei Academy whenever we feel like it!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「For example, take the new and old school buildings. They're only two stories tall, yet there are dormer windows on the roof, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That means there's definitely a secret attic up there!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm gonna find it, make it my secret base, bring Nana-chan inside, and...」
What is she planning to do?

name: Sacchin
message: 「There's gotta be a hidden staircase somewhere in the hallway ceiling!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And now, allow me to introduce the elite members of my expedition team!」
Sally-chan's outfit and hair ornament are a pale pink. If you look at it generously, I suppose you could call it red.
Sally-chan's hair is pale light blue. Taking a broad view, you could even call it blue.
What is this? Watching this sight fills me with a bittersweet sense of emptiness.
There's no trace of yellow left anywhere anymore, though that hardly matters.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, if Sally-chan is playing three roles by herself, does that mean there's only one member?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Just me and Nana-chan is plentyyy, come on, get it alreadyyy.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, um, Sally-chan's here too, so wouldn't that make three...?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, well thennn, check if there's anything suspicious on the ceilinggg. I'm not tall enough to reach it myselfyy.」

name: Sally
message: 「Sir Captain, sir, I lack the power to fly high, sir, please give me more fuel, sir.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And one more as a bonus, a region-exclusive Black Mont Blanc ice cream barrr.」

name: Sally
message: 「Munch, munch, chomp, chomp... Aah, that was deliciousss!」

name: Sally
message: 「Captain, sir, my tummy is too heavy to fly high, sir. I shall go work, exercise, and slim down, sir.」

name: Sally
message: 「Well, see ya! I've got my part-time shift at the beef bowl shop, so I'm heading out. Bye-bye.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Uuu, Synn-kun, give me a shoulder ride--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Then we'll be able to check the ceiling--」

name: Synn
message: 「A-All right, fine!\s01 I don't know if we'll even reach the ceiling, though...」
I turn my back to Sacchin and crouch down. Sacchin's soft legs rest on my shoulders.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hyau!? Kuuuun... Synn-kun's breath on my thighs--it tickles--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, ubyaaaa!? Synn! What the heck are you doing, peeking up Sacchin's skirt!?」
Nanaka came up from the stairs. Somehow, I sense the presence of a massive misunderstanding.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is it Sacchin!? You're into Sacchin!! Do you have a weird fetish!? Is that it!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehehe--but as long as Nana-chan is there with me--I don't mind doing a threesome with Synn-kun, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Court is now in session for the Sweets Club Inquisition. Both defendants shall swear to the God of Sweets to speak nothing but the truth.」
In the hallway of the old school building, I had to explain the whole series of events to Nanaka... Because it was way too absurd, it was really hard to tell.
However, Sacchin looked super happy just getting to be together with Nanaka.
